title: 第2章  筑基找元婴切磋什么
slug: 爹仙尊娘魔尊我嘎嘎乱杀
content_zh:
柳如烟的父亲跟谢逸是好友，她父母双亡后，拿着父亲遗笔书信到了玄天宗请求谢逸收留，谢逸便将这故人之女收为了弟子。
她其实比谢莲心大四岁，因为入门晚，加上实力不及谢莲心，所以喊谢莲心师姐。
“这点小事都要闹到刑罚堂来，你们这些人都这么闲吗？”谢逸道。
恐怖绝伦的威压地从他身上释放而出，整个大殿剧烈地晃动了起来，众人一个个面色惨白，战战兢兢的。不管是炼虚期、大乘期、渡劫期的弟子，还是已经成仙的诸峰峰主、长老们都一阵心惊肉跳。
柳如烟脚一软跪了下来，众弟子也全部脸色苍白地跪在了地面上。
仙盟第一高手，即使只是外泄的一丝威压都足以让众人惊骇。
谢逸看着宋璇等人，心里越发觉得这些弟子不成器了，他那小徒弟十八岁，故人之女，也许以往骄纵了些，可以理解。他们都是修行了上百年，几百年的人了，怎么一个个还跟着胡闹？
诸峰峰主、长老们出来打圆场了。
“玉阳师兄，小孩子嘛，不懂事，慢慢教就好了。”
“玉阳师兄，何必动这么大的火气呢。”
“这些小家伙们不值得师兄动怒。”
谢逸瞥了下方跪着的弟子们：“今日到场的全部弟子，宗规抄五十遍。无事生非！”
众弟子一个个心中哀嚎，五十遍啊。
宗主也太狠了！！
谢莲心心中得意，上辈子她当众顶撞谢逸，他一气之下，让她面壁十年。
谢逸站起身就要走，忽地又瞥了眼跪着的谢莲心和柳如烟，说了句，“切磋还是找同境界的吧，筑基期找元婴切磋什么？”
柳如烟身体一颤，几乎要昏死过去，谢逸这话如同钢刀似的将她脸面都刮下来了。
柳如烟的资质其实不差，应该说她算是资质上乘的了。
十八岁筑基初期已经很了不起，可是偏偏碰上了谢莲心这个怪物。
谢莲心四岁筑基，五岁结丹，十一岁结婴，现在十四岁，已经是元婴后期了。

谢莲心怪物般的资质面前，柳如烟被衬托得如同废人一般。这是柳如烟无法接受的，她妒忌，妒忌谢莲心的资质。
同样是玉阳仙尊的徒弟，差距如此之大，她心态无法不平衡。不管多少人厌恶谢莲心，也无法否认她的天赋。
师尊是嫌弃她了吗？
柳如烟泫然欲泣地望着谢逸，但谢逸说完，那身影已经消失了，众人皆对着虚空拜道：
“恭送宗主！”
谢逸一走，那些峰主长老们也走了。
谢莲心马上站起身来，她看着柳如烟，露出一个笑容：“师妹，身体如何了？还好吗？”
柳如烟强挤出笑容来：“已经好多了。”
“那太好了，误伤师妹，我心里很是过意不去呢。”谢莲心笑得灿烂。
“谢莲心，你别得意，这次算你运气好！”宋璇气得跳了出来，他本是要帮烟儿师妹讨公道的，现在好了，自己也被罚了。五十遍宗规啊，这宗规那么长，有得抄了。
其他人也是哀声怨道的，帮柳如烟打抱不平的怨气都聚焦了谢莲心，那些看热闹对柳如烟也颇有微词了。小题大做，害他们也被罚了。下次再也不来看热闹了。
“宋师兄，你是要特意找我麻烦嘛？小心师尊让你再抄五十遍宗规。”谢莲心道。
“你……”
宋璇咬牙切齿，他看着眼前的谢莲心，觉得她跟以前不一样，以前这家伙嘴巴没那么利索的。
“师妹啊，我要回玉阳峰，一起吗？”谢莲心笑看着柳如烟，笑里藏刀，口蜜腹剑，她也会的。
柳如烟狐疑地看着谢莲心，她跟宋璇一样震惊谢莲心的变化，为什么谢莲心的眼神看得让她心中发毛。
“我、我等会再回去。”
柳如烟想要时间整理自己的情绪。
谢莲心笑道：
“那我先走了。”

一转身，谢莲心的笑容就消失了。
柳如烟这女人的命，暂且留着。
等到时机到了，她会跟前世一样送她上路。上辈子一剑结果了她，便宜她了，这辈子定要让她死得无比凄惨。
————
走出刑罚堂的大殿，来到外面，视野开阔。
天空之上云彩如同极地的极光一般变幻着，云海缥缈，云海上是一座座悬空的仙岛。每一座仙岛都有着其独特的景观，或是奇花异草常开不谢；或是飞瀑流泉处处；或是奇峰险峻，或是紫雾缤纷……
谢莲心走在悬浮的万里虹桥之上，远处一轮红日正在升起，云海和无数的仙岛都在这虹桥的下方。
风吹起谢莲心的白衣飞舞。
谢莲心感受着清风吹拂，望着眼前之景，脑子疯狂地运转着。
重生，为什么她会重生？
眼前忽然浮现出了破碎的天空，燃烧的大地，日月无光，星空破碎，乾坤倾覆，无数的强者被黑天帝撕裂。黑天帝的邪恶的力量，将诸天万界一一侵蚀。她必须阻止这家伙灭世，怎么阻止他？
让她爹娘联手自然是最好的选择，但那可能吗？
这两个家伙放一起，必然是一言不合就打个你死我活。除非她说出前世之事，但是这样也不行，黑天帝的洞察之眼恐怖至极，这家伙随时随地监控诸天万界，一旦说出他的名字就会被他关注。
写下来也不行，也会他感知，甚至过分关注他都会被他感知到。
万魔之祖，魔神皇，黑天帝，魔帝，黑暗神，夜天子，罪恶之神，赤血帝，无论是他哪一个名字，只要跟他产生了联系的，都不能随意提及。
如果现在被他关注到了，她立刻完蛋了。
现在的她可没能力拉着这家伙同归于尽。
怎么会有这种恐怖的家伙存在啊！他到底从哪里冒出来的？她要怎么才能弄死他？
谢莲心脑壳儿痛，她不敢继续多想，怕想多了，被黑天帝感知了。她心中打定主意，首先先修复她跟她爹关系，然后想办法去找她娘。
谢莲心身上红色的遁光涌现，她化为了一道红色的流光朝着远处飞去。群山在身边不断地后退，谢莲心朝着玉阳峰的方向飞去。

玄天宗位于昆山山脉。
谢逸除了仙盟盟主，玄天宗宗主，同时也是昆山一百零八峰之一的玉阳峰峰主，他会称之为玉阳仙尊，就是因为他清修之所是玉阳峰。
玉阳峰上只有谢逸、谢莲心和柳如烟三人居住，谢莲心落在了玉阳峰后山。
content_en:
Liu Ruyan's father was good friends with Xie Yi. After her parents died, she took her father's posthumous letter to the Xuantian Sect and asked Xie Yi to take her in. Xie Yi then accepted the daughter of an old friend as his disciple.
She is actually four years older than Xie Lianxin. Because she started late and is not as strong as Xie Lianxin, she calls her Senior Sister Xie Lianxin.
"This trivial matter has to be brought to the punishment hall. Are you people so idle?" Xie Yi said.
Terrifying coercion was released from his body, and the entire hall shook violently. Everyone looked pale and trembling. Regardless of whether they were disciples in the Void Refining Stage, Mahayana Stage, or Tribulation Stage, or the peak masters and elders who had become immortals, they were all frightened.
Liu Ruyan's feet softened and she knelt down, and all the disciples also knelt on the ground with pale faces.
The top master of the Immortal League, even a hint of pressure leaked is enough to frighten everyone.
Xie Yi looked at Song Xuan and others and felt more and more that these disciples were useless. His little disciple was eighteen years old and the daughter of an old friend. She might have been a little arrogant in the past, which is understandable. They have all been cultivating for hundreds of years, why are they all still messing around?
The peak masters and elders of the various peaks came out to smooth things over.
"Senior Brother Yuyang, you are a child and you are not sensible. Just teach him slowly and you will be fine."
"Senior Brother Yuyang, why are you so angry?"
"These little guys are not worthy of senior brother's wrath."
Xie Yi glanced at the kneeling disciples below: "All the disciples present today have copied the sect rules fifty times. Much ado over nothing!"
All the disciples cried out in their hearts, fifty times.
The sect leader is too cruel! !
Xie Lianxin felt proud. In her previous life, she contradicted Xie Yi in public, and he got angry and made her face the wall for ten years.
Xie Yi stood up and was about to leave, but suddenly glanced at Xie Lianxin and Liu Ruyan who were kneeling, and said, "Let's compare with people of the same level. Why should we compare with Nascent Soul during the foundation building stage?"
Liu Ruyan's body trembled and she almost fainted. Xie Yi's words were like a steel knife that scraped off her face.
Liu Ruyan's qualifications are actually not bad. It should be said that she has excellent qualifications.
At the age of eighteen, he was already very impressive in the early stages of foundation building, but he happened to encounter the monster Xie Lianxin.
Xie Lianxin established her foundation at the age of four, formed elixirs at the age of five, and had a baby at the age of eleven. Now she is fourteen and is already in the late Nascent Soul stage.
In front of Xie Lianxin's monster-like qualifications, Liu Ruyan was made to look like a useless person. This was unacceptable to Liu Ruyan. She was jealous of Xie Lianxin's qualifications.
She is also the disciple of Yuyang Immortal Lord, but the gap is so huge that her mentality cannot be unbalanced. No matter how many people hate Xie Lianxin, they cannot deny her talent.
Does Master dislike her?
Liu Ruyan looked at Xie Yi with tears in her eyes, but after Xie Yi finished speaking, the figure had disappeared, and everyone bowed to the void:
"Farewell to the sect leader!"
As soon as Xie Yi left, the peak masters and elders also left.
Xie Lianxin stood up immediately. She looked at Liu Ruyan and smiled: "Junior sister, how are you? Are you okay?"
Liu Ruyan forced a smile: "It's much better already."
"That's great. I feel very sorry for accidentally injuring Junior Sister." Xie Lianxin smiled brightly.
"Xie Lianxin, don't be complacent. You are lucky this time!" Song Xuan jumped out of anger. He originally wanted to help Junior Sister Yan'er seek justice, but now he is fine and he has been punished. Fifty times the sect rules. This sect rule is so long, I have to copy it.
Others also complained bitterly, and their resentment for helping Liu Ruyan to fight against the injustice focused on Xie Lianxin. Those who were watching the fun also complained about Liu Ruyan. They were punished for making a fuss out of a molehill. I won’t come to see the excitement next time.
"Senior Brother Song, are you specifically trying to trouble me? Be careful if Master asks you to copy the sect rules fifty times again." Xie Lian thought to herself.
"You..."
Song Xuan gritted his teeth. He looked at Xie Lianxin in front of him and felt that she was different from before. In the past, this guy didn't have such a sharp mouth..
"Junior sister, I want to go back to Yuyang Peak. Can we come together?"
Liu Ruyan looked at Xie Lianxin suspiciously. She was as shocked as Song Xuan at Xie Lianxin's change. Why did Xie Lianxin's eyes make her feel hairy.
"I-I'll go back later."
Liu Ruyan wanted time to sort out her emotions.
Xie Lianxin smiled and said:
"Then I'll leave first."
As soon as she turned around, Xie Lianxin's smile disappeared.
The life of Liu Ruyan, a woman, should be kept for the time being.
When the time comes, she will send her on her way just like in her previous life. In the last life, he killed her with a sword, which gave her an advantage. In this life, she will definitely die miserably.
————
Walking out of the main hall of the Penalty Hall and outside, the view is wide.
The clouds in the sky are changing like the polar aurora, and the sea of ​​clouds is misty, and the sea of ​​clouds is a series of suspended fairy islands. Each fairy island has its own unique landscape, including exotic flowers and grasses that are always in bloom, waterfalls and springs everywhere, steep peaks, and colorful purple mist...
Xie Lianxin was walking on the suspended Wanli Rainbow Bridge. A red sun was rising in the distance. The sea of clouds and countless fairy islands were under the rainbow bridge.
The wind blew Xie Lianxin's white clothes flying.
Xie Lian felt the breeze blowing in her heart and looked at the scene in front of her, her mind running wildly.
Rebirth, why is she reborn?
Suddenly, the broken sky and the burning earth appeared in front of me. The sun and moon were without light, the starry sky was shattered, the world was overturned, and countless strong men were torn apart by the Black Heaven Emperor. The evil power of Emperor Black Heaven eroded all the heavens and realms one by one. She had to stop this guy from destroying the world. How to stop him?
Letting her parents join forces is naturally the best choice, but is that possible?
If these two guys are put together, they will definitely fight to the death if they disagree. Unless she tells what happened in her past life, but that won't work. Emperor Black Heaven's insightful eye is extremely terrifying. This guy monitors all the worlds anytime and anywhere. Once his name is spoken, he will pay attention to her.
Even if you write it down, he will sense it. Even if you pay too much attention to him, he will sense it.
The ancestor of all demons, the Demon God Emperor, the Black Heaven Emperor, the Demon Emperor, the God of Darkness, the Son of Night, the God of Sin, the Scarlet Blood Emperor, no matter which of his names he has, as long as he is associated with him, he cannot be mentioned casually.
If he paid attention to her now, she would be finished immediately.
Now she has no ability to drag this guy to die together.
How could such a terrifying guy exist? Where did he come from? How could she kill him?
Xie Lian felt a pain in her heart and head. She didn't dare to think more, for fear that if she thought too much, Emperor Heitian would sense it. She made up her mind to repair her relationship with her father first, and then find a way to find her mother.
A red escape light emerged from Xie Lianxin's body, and she turned into a stream of red light and flew towards the distance. The mountains continued to recede around him, and Xie Lianxin flew towards Yuyang Peak.
Xuantian Sect is located in the Kunshan Mountains.
In addition to being the leader of the Immortal Alliance, Xie Yi is also the leader of the Xuantian Sect. He is also the leader of Yuyang Peak, one of the 108 peaks in Kunshan. He calls it Yuyang Immortal Lord because the place where he cultivates is Yuyang Peak.
Only three people, Xie Yi, Xie Lianxin and Liu Ruyan, lived on Yuyang Peak. Xie Lianxin fell on the mountain behind Yuyang Peak.
